page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.16xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 8369B processors running at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz. With a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio, each of the 64 vCPUs maps directly to a physical core, ensuring dedicated compute resources without hyperthreading overhead. The instance is equipped with 512.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

This instance does not include local NVMe storage, requiring network-attached storage for persistent data. Network performance is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput communication with external storage volumes and other network resources. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation combined with a dense memory footprint offers a balanced resource profile for workloads requiring consistent compute performance and substantial memory capacity without the premium of GPU hardware.

Given its memory-optimized architecture and dedicated physical cores, the ecs.r7.16xlarge is designed for memory-intensive enterprise applications. It is suitable for large-scale relational databases, in-memory caching systems, enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, and memory-heavy data processing or analytics pipelines.
